summary: A three-cornered tricorn hat: a low felt crown with the brim cocked up into three flaps that meet in a point… options channel0, channel1; sockets grip_r, grip_l, holster_r, sling_back.
setup: Spawn it with Prefabs.garment_head_tricorn or place "prefab": "garment_head_tricorn" in a scene; Game(plugins=[...]) needs physics3d().
